name: PeelCornerCard
job: A card with a curling sticker corner that peels back to uncover a hidden offer, bonus or detail beneath
visitor_action: hover the corner or drag it to peel; tap peels fully on touch; Enter/Space toggles the peel, Escape flattens it
mobile: tap peels the corner in one animated motion
motion: corner curl follows pointer with real fold geometry, releases with spring ease; idle corner breathes (reduced-motion: corner pre-peeled showing message)
art_direction: Full-bleed lemon vinyl sticker sheet that IS the component: two-tone printed sunburst, halftone screen, air-bubble pinpricks and blisters, gloss laminate, ink brand strip with tick rule; a huge ~50% corner peel whose clear adhesive back shows the mirrored sunburst; revealed ink field with rotating rays, rings, halftone and a notched coupon chip
